runs.what: Coconuts — the single, and its reels.
runs._: A RUN IS A SINGLE AND ITS REELS. Mike, 2026-08-28: Coconuts is a single, E.D. Yahdah is the next single, and how Coconuts does informs how E.D. Yahdah is released. That sentence is why `outcome` exists and why a run is a thing at all.

promotes._: THE ONE-DIRECTIONAL POINTER, AND THE ANSWER TO 'SHOULD THE SYSTEM KNOW'. This release points INTO the museum by the museum's own id. That is the ALLOWED direction — story to promotion — and it crosses nothing: the museum learns nothing, gains no field and does not know this file exists. The forbidden direction is a release string reaching src/, and this is its exact inverse. E.D. Yahdah will carry the identical shape when its reels exist; it already has a museum video, landed 2026-08-26 at 6c80c1c, and that fact needs no new mechanism to be known here.
